titleZh: Tesla 2018年第一季度财报电话会议
summaryEn: The infamous Q1 2018 call where Musk dismissed analyst questions as boring and took retail-investor questions from YouTube.
summaryZh: 那场臭名昭著的2018年第一季度电话会议，马斯克认为分析师的问题很无聊而不予理会，转而回答来自 YouTube 的散户投资者问题。

segments.textEn: Tesla released earnings Wednesday and the stock fell in after-hours trading in the wake of a record loss of almost 785 million dollars on the earnings call Elon Musk expressed irritation with the media ignoring a question from an RBC analyst and decided to mix things up take a listen we're gonna go to YouTube sorry these questions are so dry they're killing me thank you our next question is from Galileo wrestle with hyper change hey great quarter thanks for having me on the call to represent retail investors I was wondering with way Moe's plans to launch an autonomous taxi service in limited markets this year if you could give us an update on the tesla network and any details surrounding the launch date or geographic rollout thanks sure so I mean that's
segments.textZh: Tesla 周三发布财报，在创纪录地亏损近7.85亿美元之后，其股价在盘后交易中下跌。在财报电话会议上，埃隆·马斯克表达了对媒体的不满，他无视了一位 RBC 分析师的问题，并决定换换方式，听一下。我们要转到 YouTube，抱歉，这些问题太枯燥了，它们快把我弄死了，谢谢。我们的下一个问题来自 HyperChange 的伽利略·雷斯尔。嘿，这个季度很棒，感谢让我参加电话会议，代表散户投资者。我想知道，鉴于韦·莫计划今年在有限的市场推出自动驾驶出租车服务，您能否向我们介绍一下 Tesla 网络的最新情况，以及围绕推出日期或地域推广的任何细节？谢谢。当然，所以我的意思是，那是

segments.textEn: thank you thank you for an interesting question all right joining us now is Ross Rubin columnist at ZDNet and the reporter of the YouTube Reporter on that call Galileo Russell founder of hyper change TV but great to have you both here with us today Galileo let's start with you you spoke with him for about 25 minutes did he say anything that surprised you in that conversation shocking or surprising but a lot of great insight in terms of the future of let's say the semi truck with platooning and making that more cost competitive with rail more details on the Tesla Network and how they think about you know rolling that out so I think we got a ton of awesome clarity on the call that long-term investors are really valuing and let's go to you as well cross
segments.textZh: 谢谢，谢谢你提出了一个有意思的问题。好了，现在加入我们的是 ZDNet 专栏作家罗斯·鲁宾，以及那通电话中 YouTube Reporter 的记者、HyperChange TV 创始人伽利略·拉塞尔，非常高兴今天你们两位都能来到这里。伽利略，我们从你开始。你和他谈了大约25分钟，他在那次谈话中有没有说什么让你感到意外的事情，令人震惊或意外的，但就未来而言提供了很多很棒的见解，比如说，半挂卡车的编队行驶，以及让它在成本上更能与铁路竞争，还有关于 Tesla Network 的更多细节，以及他们如何考虑，你知道，推出它。所以我认为，我们在这通电话中获得了大量非常棒的明确信息，而长期投资者确实很看重这些。我们也来听听你的看法，克罗斯。

segments.textEn: pulling you in here on some of the numbers so Tessa of course reporting it's the biggest loss while also beating on the on the revenue side so I do think investors should be weighing all the information they got yesterday rush they really be feeling about Tesla at this point well this is really the cause for concern on the investor side the cause for the questions about the the fundamental the technical fundamentals and it's must saying that they're going to turn it around they're going to start being profitable in the next few quarters and that's really what investors are trying to get at in terms of nailing him down on that okay Galloway I want to come back to you this you know in in spite of some of the fandom that has spurred and swirled around Tesla
segments.textZh: 请你也加入进来谈谈其中一些数字。所以 Tessa 当然报告了它最大的亏损，同时在营收方面也超出了预期。所以我确实认为，投资者应该权衡他们昨天获得的所有信息。拉什，他们目前究竟应该如何看待 Tesla？嗯，这确实是投资者一方担忧的原因，也是人们对基本面、技术基本面提出问题的原因，而马斯特说他们将扭转局面，他们将在接下来的几个季度开始盈利，而这实际上正是投资者试图追问、让他给出明确答复的事情。好的，加洛韦，我想回到你这里。尽管，你知道，围绕 Tesla 激起并盘旋着一些狂热情绪。

segments.textEn: still ramping up the portfolio they're entering the model 3 model 3 coming to market at a time when when other automakers are retreating from the sedan market so you know obviously just a different stage in the business and they're they're going to be really building out the portfolio and trying to reach a more mainstream consumer market over over the next few years Galileo tests the stock down today about six point six percent seven percent at the open so tape it off with just a bit when we look at that are you buying more Tesla here today we've talked about your bullish sentiment oh yeah I mean I'm all in on Tesla I have no money or free capital or otherwise I would definitely be buying Tesla right now I think a big reason the stock is taking a hit

segments.textZh: 是的，我认为这是一个极其重要的问题，这就是为什么我在电话会议上问了这个问题。埃隆·马斯克在回答我的问题时说，他们将发布季度数据，让这项进展大致处于什么状态变得更加透明。所以我认为，这是一个非常有意思的角度，可以看到这样的证据：比如这些就是媒体现在正在讨论的事情，媒体正在推动 Tesla 的故事演变，而这些源自电话会议上提出的问题。Galileo Russell 来到我们的演播室，他是 HyperChange TV 的创始人；Ross Rubin 也通过 Skype 加入我们，他是 ZDNet 的专栏作家。感谢两位今天来到这里参加我们的节目。
